lead.title: aci-cpp beats llama.cpp v1.0.0 on eight of ten local workloads
lead.summary: Actual's aci-cpp fork reports 17-28% faster follow-up responses on DGX Spark and 12.6 tok/s decode at 250K context on M3 Ultra, winning on eight of ten tested workloads against llama.cpp v1.0.0. The gains come from new 8-bit integer tensor-core kernels that read GGUF weights in place on NVIDIA hardware, with the same kernel family reaching RTX Blackwell cards.

top_stories.title: Gemini 4 agent teams plus Lean cut quantum simulation costs up to 10x
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents with the Lean proof assistant to develop new quantum circuits for fusion, chemistry and drug discovery, open-sourcing the verified solutions and a Lean library.

top_stories.title: GPT-6 Cyber validates 948 Linux kernel bugs and generates patches
top_stories.summary: OpenAI reports GPT-6 Cyber helped validate 948 Linux kernel bugs that could grant local root access, with maintainers working on upstream fixes.

top_stories.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B in six months on $1.75B Series F
top_stories.summary: Greenoaks and Lightspeed led the round at double its May valuation, with roughly half the Fortune 50 served and a $400M run-rate in AI customer experience.

top_stories.title: M6 Mac mini cracks Apple's $899 price at $779 for Black Friday
top_stories.summary: The new M6 pairs a 12-core CPU/GPU with Apple's first dual 16-core Neural Engine and 170 GB/s memory bandwidth, up from 153 GB/s on M5, making the cheapest desk-side local-AI box cheaper still.

items.title: Clover-35B-A3B: a diffusion language model built on Gated Delta Networks
items.summary: A 35B-total / 3B-activated MoE diffusion LM with thinking-mode generation, combining recurrent context memory with bidirectional softmax attention for efficient local deployment.

items.title: MemOnce replaces the layer-wise KV cache with reusable memory states
items.summary: The architecture swaps linear-growth token-level KV caches for reusable memory states, cutting inference-time memory on long-horizon and continual interactions.

items.title: Yggdrasil: tree-routed recurrent experts for state tracking and fast CPU inference
items.summary: Targets two limits of parallel-trainable recurrences — weak discrete state tracking and per-step full-parameter reads — aiming at faster CPU-side local inference.

items.title: MobileGrail puts compact guardrails on-device for mobile GUI agents
items.summary: Compact on-device guardrail models assess each proposed action before execution, keeping private screens local instead of shipping them to cloud multimodal models.

items.title: cmHC: better stream mixing in hyper-connections via geometric contraction
items.summary: Shows how to mix Birkhoff-polytope-constrained residual streams more effectively in manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections for stable, low-overhead propagation.

items.title: Xing4.1-Preview: 285B/17B MoE trained on a fully domestic stack, 1M native context
items.summary: A 256-routed-expert MoE (top-8 + 1 shared, MLA + DSA) built on MindSpore for agentic coding and long-horizon workflows, Apache 2.0, running on SGLang and vLLM with llama.cpp support pending.

items.title: IVE-4B and Ivonnet-0.8B: open decision models that score 255 options in one pass
items.summary: Apache-2.0 decision models for reranking, page relevance, classification, KIE, chart reading and web actions; IVE-4B ranks first of 166 models up to 5B on the private Decision Index after ~13h of training on 4x H100.

items.title: MoziAier-35B-V3.9: finance-focused multimodal MoE in a 12.99 GB hybrid-quantized GGUF
items.summary: A Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-architecture MoE with vision and tool calling, 256K context and in-house MoziSmartBit quantization (PPL +0.47% vs BF16), running from 8 GB VRAM with offload.

items.title: Show HN: Gal — local-first agent runtime with per-call permissions and rollback
items.summary: Gal gives coding agents per-call permission grants and snapshot-based rollback, a minimal self-contained way to run agents with auditable tool permissions.

items.title: Show HN: FireVoice — open-source voice studio running on your own GPU
items.summary: A free local TTS/voice studio that runs entirely on your GPU without cloud accounts, pairing with local LLM stacks.

items.title: Show HN: Benchline — 61 free dev tools exposed as MCP tools
items.summary: Benchline packages 61 developer utilities as Model Context Protocol tools so local agents can call them directly, without cloud dependencies.

items.title: Community comparison: which self-hosted LLM tracing stacks survive a 2 GB memory limit
items.summary: Identical-trace measurements of Langfuse, Opik, Phoenix, MLflow, Laminar, Agenta and AcruxCore show idle memory from 0.39 GiB up to 4.5 GiB — useful for picking a lightweight tracing backend on a small VPS or Pi.

items.title: Songe: a local proxy that fine-tunes your model on agent traces while idle
items.summary: The Apache-2.0 proxy sits between agents and model servers, records tool results and corrections, and trains small LoRA adapters via on-policy self-distillation with held-out checks and one-click rollback. No account, no telemetry.

items.title: n8n 2.48.8 fixes Migration Report access and adds MCP trigger failure reporting
items.summary: The current latest release also resolves an expression memory-limit throw on the quickjs engine for self-hosted instances.

items.title: Nov 23 bench digest: 512GB M5 Ultra tops single-box decode; Mac Studio beats two DGX Sparks on 256K prefill
items.summary: Community runs show TensorFold driving DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to 56-80 tok/s decode on one 512GB M5 Ultra, a Mac Studio M5 Max reaching 89.8 tok/s on GLM 5.3 Flash at 256K context, and Metal-kernel optimizations lifting Inkling 2 Small prefill 192%.

items.title: Black Friday RAM deals: DDR5 kits discounted amid the memory pricing crisis
items.summary: Tom's Hardware's tracker lists cuts like the Corsair Vengeance RGB 32GB at $469.99 from $579.99, while Team Group's GM expects the DRAM shortage to worsen in 2026 before normalizing in 2027-2028.

items.title: RigBase DGX Spark recipe table: 18 setups for 11 open models, up to 95.1 tok/s
items.summary: Recipes span one to four 128GB Sparks, including Qwen3.6 35B-A3B at 95.1 tok/s (NVFP4 + MTP, vLLM) on a single Spark, with memory math for 27B-753B models.
